open_items: ECB flapped degraded twice in 6 hours: cycle 1216 (reported previously) and cycle 1218 (this run), separated by one clean healthy cycle (1217). The 1218 flap was broader than 1216's: gateway data failed outright (not just needing a retry) and all three direct checks failed (504/504/500), vs. 1216 where direct metadata still passed. Healthy again at 1219; live recheck now confirms fast, normal responses on direct checks and all contract probes. Not closing the watch item: two flares in three cycles reads as continuing instability. Watch for a third.

ESTAT had an unreported gateway_issue flap at cycle 1215 (gateway metadata failed with a blank error message; direct checks all stayed ok). It fell inside the previous run's comparison window but was not reported then; recorded now as already resolved, per the fail-and-recover rule. The blank error message matches a previously-flagged bug on ABS (cycle 26) now recurring on a different endpoint; worth a code fix so the next occurrence is diagnosable.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1219. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
127 claude/ triage branches on origin as of this run (up from 126 at cycle 1216). Still above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

main is still only through cycle 1168, now 51 cycles behind. This run's own merge-to-main attempt is reported separately in the session output; if it fails too, findings stay recorded on this branch and the next run's branch-scan will pick them up.

Monitor bug noted previously: /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status. Not re-confirmed this run since no contract-only state occurred, but still believed true.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); BIS/ILO/IMF references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); ABS/ILO/OECD encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict always stays ok.
